name: DOUBLE JEOPARDY: THE SLUM LORD EDITION

clues.question: This common dorm insect infestation shares its name with a mattress manufacturer's worst nightmare.
The mysterious green fuzz growing in the communal microwave of this specific dorm hall is probably a new life form.
This appliance is technically banned in your room, but you still use it to make 3 AM depressed ramen.
The absolute maximum number of days you can go without washing your bedsheets before they gain sentience.
This legal document you signed without reading gives your landlord the right to harvest your organs for back rent.
The gesture of swiping this direction means you hate yourself and everyone else on Tinder.
This photo angle used by 90% of dudes on Bumble is designed to hide a weak chin and a massive beer gut.
Your ex's bio on Hinge literally says this cliché phrase about loving 'tacos and adventure'.
The medical term for the soul-crushing numbness you feel after getting ghosted for the fourth time this week.
This paid feature lets you see which desperate souls accidentally swiped right on your goblin face.
The blinding headache and existential dread you feel after drinking an entire box of Franzia.
Greasy hangover food that somehow cures all ailments except your terrible life choices.
clues.answer: What is a bacon egg and cheese?

clues.question: The feeling of deep psychological terror when you check your bank account and see a $400 tab at a strip club.
The anatomical term for the body part you most likely threw up on after doing tequila shots.
The scientific name for the disgusting grey liquid left in a Solo cup outside your room for three days.
This federal loan provider haunts your dreams and ruins your credit score before you even turn 22.
The useless piece of paper you receive at graduation that cost forty grand and qualifies you to work at Starbucks.
clues.answer: What is a liberal arts degree?

clues.question: The grim economic reality that you will be paying off interest until the heat death of the universe.
The number of kidneys you have to sell on the black market to afford a single textbook.
This mythical political promise to wipe out all student loans is basically the adult version of Santa Claus.
Dropping the ping pong ball in the beer cup during this classic red cup game means you must chug in shame.
The absolute garbage domestic beer that every broke college party insists on buying in bulk.
The guy at the kickback who brings an acoustic guitar and forces everyone to listen to his terrible cover of Wonderwall.
clues.answer: Who is the acoustic guitar guy?

clues.question: The illegal substance your sketchy roommate claims is 'pure MDMA' but is actually crushed-up vitamins and drywall.
The unwritten rule of the party house that states whoever breaks the IKEA coffee table must replace it with cash.
clues.answer: What is you break it you buy it?
